after.zh: 「等于周围最大值」的格子才是峰顶：这叫非极大值抑制（NMS）。一块 3×3 的最大值可以拆成先横后竖，和可分离的模糊一个道理。
after.en: Only a cell equal to the largest around it is a top: this is called non-maximum suppression (NMS). The maximum over a 3×3 block splits into across then down, just like a separable blur.

t.zh: 响应图一过门槛，留下的是一片一片：一个角附近有好几格都很强。可一个角只该是一个点。
t.en: Above a threshold a response map leaves patches: several cells near one corner are all strong. But a corner should be a single point.

t.zh: 一片里真正的位置是它的峰顶：比四周都高的那一格。
t.en: The true position in a patch is its top: the cell higher than everything around it.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：一张响应图上有几个鼓包，只在峰顶输出 1。
t.en: Your task in this level: a response map has a few bumps; output 1 only at their tops.

desc.zh: 比 3×3 邻居都不小、又大于 0.3 的格子输出 1，其余输出 0。
desc.en: Outputs 1 where a cell is no smaller than its 3×3 neighbours and above 0.3, and 0 elsewhere.

brief.zh: 一张响应图上有几个鼓包。只在峰顶输出 1：这一格比 3×3 邻居都不小，而且大于 0.3。
brief.en: A response map has a few bumps. Output 1 only at the tops: a cell no smaller than any of its 3×3 neighbours, and above 0.3.

hint.zh: 先算出每一格周围 3×3 里最大的是多少。<part-ref to="max"></part-ref>一次只比两张图，可以先横着比、再竖着比。
hint.en: First work out the largest value in the 3×3 around each cell. <part-ref to="max"></part-ref> compares only two pictures at a time, so compare across first, then down.
